blocks.content: Planning to appear for CUET UG 2027? Understanding eligibility criteria is the first step toward securing admission in top universities. While the National Testing Agency allows a broad range of students to appear, individual universities may impose additional conditions regarding subjects, minimum marks and course-specific qualifications.
What is the Eligibility for CUET 2027?

The basic eligibility criteria for CUET UG 2027 require candidates to have passed or be appearing in Class 12 from a recognized board such as CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, NIOS, or any equivalent examination. There is currently no upper age limit for appearing in the CUET examination, making it accessible to both fresh Class 12 students and gap-year candidates. The National Testing Agency (NTA) does not prescribe a minimum percentage requirement for the entrance test itself; however, participating universities may specify minimum marks, subject combinations, and course-specific qualifications for admission. Therefore, students should not only check CUET 2027 eligibility criteria but also carefully review the eligibility requirements of their preferred universities and courses before applying.

blocks.content: Who Can Apply for CUET 2027?

Students who have passed or are appearing in Class 12 from a recognized board are eligible to apply for CUET UG 2027. The examination is open to candidates from CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, NIOS and other recognized educational institutions. Fresh Class 12 students, gap-year candidates, previous-year pass-outs and eligible international applicants can all appear for CUET, provided they satisfy the eligibility requirements of the universities and courses they wish to apply for. While the National Testing Agency (NTA) conducts the examination, final admission eligibility is determined by the participating universities.

CUET 2027 Age Limit: Is There Any Maximum Age?

No, there is currently no upper age limit for appearing in CUET UG 2027. According to the National Testing Agency (NTA), candidates of any age can apply for the examination provided they meet the required educational qualifications. This means Class 12 appearing students, previous-year pass-outs, gap-year candidates and even older applicants seeking undergraduate admissions are eligible to take the test. However, while NTA does not impose an age restriction, participating universities may prescribe additional eligibility conditions for certain courses. Therefore, candidates should always verify university-specific admission requirements before applying.
Can Gap-Year Students and Older Candidates Apply for CUET 2027?

Yes. Students who completed Class 12 in previous years can apply for CUET 2027 without any restriction on the year of passing. Whether you passed Class 12 recently or several years ago, you can appear for the examination if you satisfy the university's admission criteria. This flexibility makes CUET an attractive option for drop-year students, career changers and candidates seeking admission after a break in their education.

blocks.content: Can Gap-Year Students Apply for CUET 2027?

Yes, gap-year students are fully eligible to apply for CUET UG 2027. The National Testing Agency (NTA) does not impose any restriction on the year in which a candidate passed Class 12. Students who completed their higher secondary education in 2026, 2025 or even earlier years can appear for CUET provided they satisfy the eligibility requirements of their chosen universities and courses. This flexibility allows students who took a drop year for competitive exam preparation, personal reasons, skill development or career planning to continue pursuing admission to top universities through CUET.

Candidates should note that while CUET permits previous-year pass-outs to appear for the examination, admission eligibility is ultimately determined by the participating universities. Some courses may require specific subject combinations, minimum marks in Class 12 or additional eligibility conditions. Therefore, students should carefully review the admission guidelines of universities such as Delhi University (DU), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) and other participating institutions before submitting their applications.
Educational Qualification Required for CUET 2027

To be eligible for CUET UG 2027, candidates must have passed or be appearing in Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. Students from CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, NIOS and other recognized educational boards are generally eligible to apply. The National Testing Agency (NTA) allows both fresh candidates and students awaiting their Class 12 results to register for the examination, provided they satisfy the admission requirements of their chosen universities at the time of counseling and admission.

It is important to understand that meeting the basic educational qualification for CUET does not automatically guarantee admission to every course. Participating universities may prescribe additional eligibility criteria such as minimum marks in Class 12, specific subject combinations, stream requirements or course-specific qualifications. Therefore, candidates should verify the admission requirements of their preferred universities before selecting their CUET subjects and submitting their application.

blocks.content: Minimum Marks Required for CUET 2027

The National Testing Agency (NTA) does not prescribe any minimum percentage requirement for appearing in CUET UG 2027. Students who have passed or are appearing in Class 12 from a recognized board can register for the examination regardless of their percentage. However, admission to universities through CUET is governed by the eligibility criteria of individual institutions, many of which specify minimum marks requirements for different courses and categories.

Candidates should understand that qualifying for CUET and qualifying for university admission are two different things. While there is no minimum percentage required to take the CUET examination, universities such as Delhi University (DU), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) and other participating institutions may require a certain percentage in Class 12, specific subject combinations or additional eligibility conditions depending on the course selected.

Subject Eligibility and CUET Subject Selection

Choosing the correct subjects in CUET UG 2027 is one of the most important steps in the admission process. Participating universities use subject mapping rules to determine whether a candidate is eligible for a particular course. Even a high CUET score may not result in admission if the required subjects were not selected during registration. Therefore, students should finalize their target universities and courses before choosing their CUET subjects.

Different courses require different combinations of language papers, domain subjects and the General Test. For example, some commerce programs may require Accountancy or Mathematics, while science programs typically require subjects such as Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Mathematics. Students aiming for admissions through Delhi University (DU), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) and other participating universities should carefully verify the official subject requirements before completing the CUET application form.

CUET 2027 Eligibility for Commerce Students

Commerce students are among the largest groups of candidates appearing for CUET UG 2027. Students who have completed or are appearing in Class 12 with Commerce subjects can apply for a wide range of undergraduate programs including B.Com, B.Com (Hons.), BBA, BMS, Economics, Management Studies, Banking, Finance and several multidisciplinary courses offered by participating universities. Eligibility requirements may vary depending on the university and course selected.

While Commerce students are generally eligible for most commerce-related programs, some universities require specific subject combinations in both Class 12 and CUET. For example, certain B.Com (Hons.) and Economics programs may require Mathematics as a mandatory subject, while others may accept Accountancy, Business Studies or related commerce subjects. Students should carefully verify the subject mapping requirements of universities such as Delhi University (DU), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) and other participating institutions before choosing their CUET subjects.

CUET 2027 Eligibility for Science Students

Science students have some of the widest admission opportunities through CUET UG 2027. Candidates from both PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) and PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) backgrounds can apply for a variety of undergraduate programs offered by participating universities. In addition to traditional science courses such as B.Sc Physics, B.Sc Chemistry, B.Sc Mathematics and B.Sc Biology, science students may also be eligible for several commerce, management and humanities programs depending on university-specific admission requirements.

Most science-related courses require students to appear in relevant CUET domain subjects. For example, engineering-oriented programs may require Physics and Mathematics, while life science programs may require Biology and Chemistry. Some universities also allow science students to apply for B.Com, BBA, Economics and multidisciplinary programs, provided they satisfy the required subject combinations. Students should carefully review the eligibility and subject mapping guidelines of universities such as Delhi University (DU), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) and other participating institutions before finalizing their CUET subject selection.

CUET 2027 Eligibility for Humanities Students

Humanities and Arts students can access a wide range of undergraduate courses through CUET UG 2027. Candidates who have completed or are appearing in Class 12 with subjects such as History, Political Science, Geography, Sociology, Psychology, Economics, English or other humanities disciplines are eligible to apply for numerous programs offered by participating universities. Popular options include BA (Hons.), Journalism, Mass Communication, Social Sciences, Political Science, Psychology, Public Administration and several multidisciplinary courses.

In addition to traditional Arts programs, many universities also allow humanities students to apply for management and commerce-related courses such as BBA, BMS and selected interdisciplinary programs, provided they meet the required subject combinations and eligibility conditions. Students should carefully verify university-specific requirements because certain courses may require particular CUET domain subjects, language papers or the General Test.

Can NIOS Students Apply for CUET 2027?

Yes, students who have completed or are appearing for their Class 12 examination through the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) are generally eligible to apply for CUET UG 2027. The National Testing Agency (NTA) recognizes candidates from NIOS and other recognized educational boards for the purpose of appearing in the examination. As a result, NIOS students can compete for admissions to various undergraduate programs offered through participating universities.

However, appearing for CUET and securing admission are two separate processes. While NIOS students are eligible to take the examination, universities may have additional admission requirements related to subject combinations, minimum marks, stream eligibility or course-specific qualifications. Therefore, candidates should carefully review the eligibility criteria of their preferred universities before applying.

Can Previous-Year Students Apply for CUET 2027?

Yes, candidates who completed Class 12 in previous years are eligible to apply for CUET UG 2027. The National Testing Agency (NTA) does not impose any restriction based on the year of passing, allowing previous-year pass-outs to appear for the examination and compete for admissions to participating universities. Whether a student passed Class 12 in 2026, 2025 or earlier, they can generally apply for CUET provided they satisfy the admission requirements of their chosen universities and courses.

This flexibility benefits students who took a gap year for competitive exam preparation, career exploration, skill development, personal reasons or other educational pursuits. However, while previous-year students are eligible to appear for CUET, universities may prescribe additional conditions related to minimum marks, subject combinations, stream requirements or course-specific qualifications. Candidates should therefore verify the latest admission guidelines before submitting their applications.

Students planning to seek admission through Delhi University (DU), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) and other CUET-participating universities should check course-specific eligibility criteria because admission requirements may differ across institutions and programs.
University-Wise Eligibility Through CUET 2027

Although CUET UG 2027 provides a common entrance platform for admissions, each participating university follows its own eligibility criteria, subject mapping rules and course-specific admission requirements. Students should carefully review the admission guidelines of their preferred universities before selecting CUET subjects and submitting applications.

blocks.content: Delhi University (DU) Eligibility Through CUET 2027

Delhi University admits students to undergraduate programs through CUET scores. Candidates must appear in the appropriate language and domain subjects required for their chosen course. Subject mapping is extremely important because eligibility for programs such as B.Com (Hons.), BA (Hons.), Economics and Science courses depends on the specific CUET subjects selected. Students should verify course-wise eligibility requirements through the official DU admission guidelines.
Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Eligibility Through CUET 2027

Banaras Hindu University uses CUET scores for admission to numerous undergraduate programs across arts, commerce and science streams. Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification requirements and subject combinations prescribed for their chosen course. Eligibility requirements may vary across departments and programs.
Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) Eligibility Through CUET 2027

Jamia Millia Islamia accepts CUET scores for several undergraduate courses. Students should carefully review course-specific eligibility criteria because subject requirements, minimum marks conditions and admission procedures may differ depending on the program selected.
Allahabad University Eligibility Through CUET 2027

Allahabad University considers CUET scores for admissions to various undergraduate programs. Candidates must satisfy both the university's educational qualification requirements and the course-specific eligibility conditions applicable to their chosen program.
Other Universities Accepting CUET 2027 Scores

Apart from DU, BHU, JMI and Allahabad University, several central, state, deemed and private universities use CUET scores for undergraduate admissions. Eligibility requirements vary across institutions, making it important for students to review the latest admission brochures before applying.
